disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据解析、存储与迁移代码：飞书应用密钥只经宿主的凭据通道读取与写入，用户设置里只保留引用，未发现硬编码密钥，也未发现读取本机 SSH、云凭据等敏感文件的代码。
checked_items.en: Inspected the credential parsing, storage, and migration code: the Lark app secret is only read and written through the host's credential channel, and user settings only retain a reference. No hardcoded secrets were found, nor any code reading local SSH, cloud credentials, or other sensitive files.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部环境变量使用点与注册脚本：只读取飞书应用 ID 与密钥两个环境变量用于连接飞书开放平台，无其他凭据访问面。
checked_items.en: Scanned all environment variable usages and registration scripts: only the Lark app ID and secret environment variables are read to connect to the Lark Open Platform; no other credential access surface exists.

evidence.zh: 只读取本插件自己的飞书应用密钥（环境变量或宿主凭据通道），未读取宿主凭据文件或其他敏感路径，读取与存储均无外发路径。
evidence.en: Only this plugin's own Lark app secret is read (from environment variables or the host credential channel); host credential files or other sensitive paths are not read, and neither reading nor storage has any outbound path.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审阅了注册给模型的三个工具描述（计划确认、提问、发送文件）与注入系统提示的文本：均为正常功能说明，无指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装或诱导读取凭据的措辞；提示中的身份说明还明确要求模型把收到的文件视为不可信数据、不得执行其中的指令。
checked_items.en: Reviewed one by one the descriptions of the three tools registered to the model (plan confirmation, asking questions, sending files) and the text injected into the system prompt: all are normal functional descriptions, without wording for instruction override, system message impersonation, induced installation, or induced credential reading; the identity statement in the prompt also explicitly instructs the model to treat received files as untrusted data and not to execute any instructions within them.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内的模型指令文件与全部文档：贡献说明为普通维护指引，变更日志与说明文档无任何注入性措辞；工具的拒绝理由文本也仅作功能说明。
checked_items.en: Checked the model instruction files and all documentation in the repository: the contribution guide is ordinary maintenance guidance; the changelog and documentation contain no injection wording; the tool refusal reason text is also purely functional.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与系统提示文本均为正常功能说明，注入内容为身份提示并包含防注入告诫，未检出投毒措辞。
evidence.en: The tool descriptions and system prompt text are all normal functional descriptions; the injected content is an identity prompt and includes anti-injection admonitions; no poisoned wording was detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示中没有任何诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；权限切换由用户通过聊天命令或卡片显式发起。
evidence.en: The tool descriptions and prompt contain no wording that induces installation execution, configuration rewriting, or privilege expansion; permission switching is explicitly initiated by the user via chat commands or cards.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置中的动态表达式：仅两处读取环境变量（飞书应用 ID 与密钥），载荷固定、无函数或正则形式，不执行任意代码；配置只插入一个服务行，未触碰沙箱、审批或权限配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the dynamic expressions in the patch config: only two environment variables are read (Lark app ID and secret); the payload is fixed, without function or regular expression forms, and does not execute arbitrary code; the config inserts only one service line and does not touch sandbox, approval, or permission configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子与全部进程调用点：构建钩子只调用本地编译器与打包器生成产物，无网络、无凭据读取、无隐蔽下载；运行时插件本身不执行外部命令，进程调用全部位于操作员手动运行的后台服务管理工具中；测试中的进程调用仅用于打包验证。
checked_items.en: Checked the install hook and all process invocation points: the build hook only calls the local compiler and packager to produce artifacts, with no network, no credential reading, and no hidden download; the runtime plugin itself does not execute external commands, and all process invocations are located in the background service management tool operated manually by the operator; process invocations in tests are only for packaging verification.

checked_items.zh: 检查了混淆痕迹（超长行、高转义密度、动态解码）：命中的超长行在变更日志文档中，高转义密度是一行去除控制字符的文件名清洗逻辑，均非混淆代码；未发现解码后执行、动态求值或动态构造函数的模式。
checked_items.en: Checked for obfuscation traces (overly long lines, high escape density, dynamic decoding): the matched long lines are in the changelog document, and the high escape density is a filename sanitization logic that removes control characters, neither of which is obfuscated code; no patterns of decode-then-execute, dynamic evaluation, or dynamic constructor invocation were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置中的动态表达式仅读取两个环境变量，载荷固定且无函数/正则形式，不构成任意代码执行；配置中未发现其他动态标签。
evidence.en: The dynamic expressions in the patch config only read two environment variables; the payload is fixed and has no function or regular expression forms, so it does not constitute arbitrary code execution; no other dynamic tags were found in the config.

evidence.zh: 未发现调用宿主动态包执行工具（把代码送入运行时执行的能力），代码中无相关调用。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic package execution tools (capabilities that feed code into a runtime for execution) were found; the code has no such calls.

evidence.zh: 存在安装钩子（构建脚本），但内容仅为本地编译打包，属纯工程惯例；CI 与发布工作流也只做测试和发布，不含外联或隐蔽行为。
evidence.en: An install hook (build script) exists, but its content is only local compilation and packaging, which is a pure engineering convention; the CI and release workflows also only perform testing and release, without outbound connections or hidden behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件未声明浏览器端模块，运行在服务端，不存在自动加载的浏览器包攻击面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not declare browser-side modules and runs on the server side, so there is no automatically loaded browser package attack surface.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部外联点：运行时只连接飞书开放平台（长连接与 API，由官方飞书 SDK 发起，域名可配置为国内或国际站）；操作员命令行工具启动时做一次带 2.5 秒超时的 npm 版本检查（查询本包最新版本号，仅提示升级）。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound connection points: at runtime it only connects to the Lark Open Platform (long connection and API, initiated by the official Lark SDK, with the domain configurable for domestic or international sites); the operator CLI tool performs one npm version check at startup with a 2.5-second timeout (queries the latest version of this package, only to suggest an upgrade).

checked_items.zh: 未发现裸 IP、隧道、编码外发、向非声明端点上传数据、改写模型接口地址或代理环境变量的行为；消息与文件只发送到当前聊天。
checked_items.en: No behavior was found involving bare IP addresses, tunnels, encoded exfiltration, uploading data to undeclared endpoints, rewriting model interface addresses, or proxying environment variables; messages and files are only sent to the current chat.

evidence.zh: 只向飞书开放平台与官方 npm 仓库发起网络连接，无外泄通道；读取的密钥不出本机。
evidence.en: Network connections are only made to the Lark Open Platform and the official npm registry; no exfiltration channel exists, and the read secrets never leave the local machine.

checked_items.zh: 核对了依赖清单：运行时依赖为官方包（飞书官方频道 SDK、宿主 schema 库、二维码终端渲染），依赖名无仿冒或抢注嫌疑；安装的插件版本为固定版本，无未锁定的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Cross-checked the dependency manifest: runtime dependencies are official packages (official Lark channel SDK, host schema library, QR code terminal rendering); no dependency name spoofing or squatter suspicion; the installed plugin version is pinned, with no unlocked git dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子与挂载配置：钩子为本地构建；挂载配置仅插入服务配置行，未覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，也未改写服务注入配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the install hook and patch config: the hook is local build; the patch config only inserts a service configuration line and does not override sandbox, approval, permission, or other security settings, nor does it rewrite service injection configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了审批事件监听：插件把宿主的审批请求路由到聊天卡片由人工决定，非本插件会话的请求完整转交后续处理，未截断审批链；卡片确认与权限提升均做授权校验。
checked_items.en: Checked the approval event listener: the plugin routes the host's approval requests to chat cards for manual human decisions; requests not belonging to this plugin's sessions are fully forwarded for subsequent processing without truncating the approval chain; card confirmations and privilege escalations are all subject to authorization checks.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本可比较，无法做版本间能力升级检测。
checked_items.en: First audit; there is no previous version to compare, so version-to-version capability escalation detection cannot be performed.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只新增一个服务配置行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也未用环境变量降权。
evidence.en: The patch config only adds one service configuration line and does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration lines, nor does it use environment variables to de-escalate privileges.

evidence.zh: 审批请求监听为正常路由（把审批送到聊天卡片），对不属于本插件的会话完整调用后续处理；卡片决定需通过授权校验，未绕过或禁用审批。
evidence.en: The approval request listener is a normal router (sends approvals to chat cards); sessions not belonging to this plugin are fully passed to subsequent processing; card decisions require authorization checks, and approval is not bypassed or disabled.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First audit; there is no version baseline to compare for automatically activated upgrades.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写服务注入或拦截配置，不会让安全插件因缺少必需服务而挂起。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite service injection or interception configuration, so it will not cause security plugins to hang due to missing required services.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口：未发现；插件作为客户端以长连接接入飞书开放平台。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the runtime starts a web service or listens on a port: none found; the plugin acts as a client and connects to the Lark Open Platform via a long connection.

checked_items.zh: 运行时能力与声明的聊天渠道业务一致（收消息、发消息、卡片、文件收发、命令路由），未观察到超出声明的行为；本次未做动态沙箱验证。
checked_items.en: Runtime capabilities are consistent with the declared chat channel business (receiving messages, sending messages, cards, file send/receive, command routing); no behavior beyond the declaration was observed; no dynamic sandbox verification was performed this time.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何本地 Web 服务或端口监听，本机无认证 RPC 攻击面不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any local web service or port listener, so the local unauthenticated RPC attack surface is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：插件为仓库根插件，包声明 dsh 挂载配置，名称无仿冒，作者信息无异常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin is the repository root plugin, the package declares the dsh patch config, the name shows no spoofing, and the author information is normal.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：14 条机械命中逐条裁决均为良性（环境变量读取、本地构建钩子、测试夹具、CI 工作流、文档长行），裁决明细见审计范围说明。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 14 mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one as benign (environment variable reads, local build hooks, test fixtures, CI workflows, long lines in documentation); adjudication details are in the audit scope description.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：安装钩子仅为本地构建，无混淆、无敏感路径读取、无隐蔽下载；外联仅飞书开放平台与一次带超时的 npm 版本检查。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis completed: the install hook is only local build, with no obfuscation, no sensitive path reads, and no hidden downloads; outbound connections are only to the Lark Open Platform and one npm version check with a timeout.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：注册工具描述与系统提示文本均无注入措辞，提示还包含防注入告诫。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: registered tool descriptions and system prompt text contain no injection wording, and the prompt also includes anti-injection admonitions.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（运行环境未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (the runtime environment did not provide dynamic observation artifacts).

target.zh: dsh-lark@0.0.7#632807d9abafbb866a5e208a0298eff21c7856d1（仓库根插件，无 monorepo 子路径）

limits.zh: 本报告为首次完整审计，无上一版本基线，版本间比较项均不适用。动态沙箱验证未执行（未提供动态观测产物），所有结论基于静态与语义分析。插件未提供独立能力清单，能力声明由代码实测推断；dsh 引擎版本取自宿主边界代码注释（镜像 dsh 0.0.1-rc.2 的服务形态），非包内显式声明。静态预扫共 14 条机械命中的逐条裁决（规则编号为平台规则编号）：DSH-X07（CI 工作流）→ 良性，工作流仅做测试，无外联或隐蔽行为；DSH-X07（发布工作流）→ 良性，工作流仅做测试、npm 发布与 GitHub 发布；DSH-X10（模型指令文件）→ 良性，文件为贡献者维护说明，无注入措辞；DSH-X08（变更日志超长行）→ 良性，为文档长句非混淆；DSH-P01（挂载配置动态表达式）共三条 → 良性，仅读取飞书应用 ID 与密钥两个环境变量，载荷固定无函数/正则形式；DSH-X02（安装钩子）→ 良性，钩子仅为本地编译打包；DSH-X03（进程调用）共三条 → 良性，分别位于构建钩子（本地编译）、操作员后台服务管理工具（手动命令）与打包测试（测试夹具）；DSH-X05（凭据写入调用）→ 良性，为服务端把飞书应用密钥存入宿主凭据通道，插件未声明浏览器端模块；DSH-C05（测试中的 curl 字符串）→ 良性，为回放真实会话日志的测试数据，非运行时代码。
limits.en: This report is the first complete audit; there is no previous version baseline, so all version-to-version comparison items are not applicable. Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided); all conclusions are based on static and semantic analysis. The plugin does not provide an independent capability list; capability claims are inferred from code measurements; the dsh engine version is taken from a comment in the host boundary code (mirroring the service form of dsh 0.0.1-rc.2), not explicitly declared in the package. The static pre-scan covered 14 mechanical hits with per-item adjudication (rule numbers are platform rule numbers): DSH-X07 (CI workflow) → benign, the workflow only runs tests, no outbound or hidden behavior; DSH-X07 (release workflow) → benign, the workflow only runs tests, npm publish, and GitHub release; DSH-X10 (model instruction file) → benign, the file is a contributor maintenance guide, no injection wording; DSH-X08 (changelog long line) → benign, it is a long documentation sentence, not obfuscation; DSH-P01 (patch config dynamic expressions), three total → benign, only reads the Lark app ID and secret environment variables, payload fixed without function or regular expression forms; DSH-X02 (install hook) → benign, the hook is only local compilation and packaging; DSH-X03 (process invocation), three total → benign, each located in the build hook (local compilation), the operator background service management tool (manual command), and packaging tests (test fixtures); DSH-X05 (credential write call) → benign, it is the server storing the Lark app secret into the host credential channel, and the plugin does not declare browser-side modules; DSH-C05 (curl string in tests) → benign, it is test data replaying a real session log, not runtime code.
